question: Independent protocol-level effects of five executable action handlers; no diagnostic/policy comparison

network.loss: LogDistance, exponent 3, reference distance 1m, reference loss 46.6777dB
network.topology: Four nodes, two ad-hoc links, same channel. Primary controller=(0,0,0), UAV initially=(15,0,0); external sender=(0,20,0), receiver=(15,20,0).
network.M1: UAV moves +x at 3.5m/s from t=1 to t=21; same trajectory in every action arm
network.W1: 1200-byte external UDP packets every 1200us, 8Mbps offered, t in [1,21)
network.V1: 1200-byte video packets every 800us in the first 500ms of each 1s period, 12Mbps burst / 6Mbps mean offered

handlers.WiFiRelief: UAV AC_BE CWmin=63, CWmax=1023, AIFSN=7; original defaults are CWmin=15 CWmax=1023 AIFSN=3; existing queues and in-flight packets retained
handlers.LinkAdapt: Both primary nodes ConstantRateWifiManager DataMode becomes OfdmRate6Mbps; control mode, power, channel and propagation unchanged; no device rebuild or modeled extra retune outage
handlers.VideoShape: UAV video application FIFO with 128-packet limit, packet-paced at 4Mbps; first eligible dequeue at action activation; existing network queue unchanged; new offered demand remains fixed
handlers.FallbackProtect: Controller C2 socket IP ToS=0xC0 (UP6/AC_VO), plus the same UAV video FIFO paced at 1Mbps; already submitted packets keep their original classification

drain: Generators stop at 21s; shaper keeps dequeuing until 23s; sinks stay active. Shaper full-drop and socket rejection are explicit terminal outcomes. Network non-delivery by 23s is a horizon outcome, not an asserted permanent physical loss.
video_primary_definition: Unique payload bytes first received by 23s among packets offered in [11,21), divided by all video bytes offered in [11,21); offered denominator includes shaper drops and socket failures

statistics.primary_contrasts: Four actions minus Observe on each of the two primary endpoints; eight tests
statistics.estimand: Equal-weight average over eight fixed scenarios, within each of 16 independent RNG run blocks
statistics.test: Exhaustive two-sided 2^16 paired block sign-flip, absolute mean difference, including equality; assumes sign exchangeability under the null
statistics.bootstrap: 10000 paired 16-block resamples, common indices across actions/scenarios/endpoints; percentile pointwise 95% intervals
statistics.multiplicity: All eight primary tests added to the archived 93-test inventory; report within-eight and complete pooled-101 Holm/BH. Scenario and secondary results descriptive.

engineering_gates: identical observable pre-command ledgers across five arms
all packet and byte partitions conserved
actual C2 QoS header TID6 after Fallback activation
fixed binary/input hashes across formal runs
claim_boundary: Independent packet-level discrete-event simulation, using one public transport-emission input case. No field outcome, original 25D diagnostic, BLE/RID coexistence, or end-to-end policy superiority is established. Do not select the best action retrospectively and call it the proposed policy. Retain every run, effect direction and unresolved outcome.
